request.title: Lan faces the choice
request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single 16:9 cinematic high-fidelity dark fantasy painting for a campaign trailer. Lan, the dark-haired male adventurer with a stern face from reference 1, stands alone on a vast wind-swept stone causeway at dusk. A subtle crimson supernatural glow follows his raised hand while cold blue light breaks through storm clouds in the distance, expressing a grave moral choice. Show his entire head and upper body safely inside the frame, with sweeping environment filling the width. He should look like a compelling human adventurer rather than a god or a modern actor. Painterly, detailed, restrained red accents, deep blue shadows, dramatic atmosphere consistent with the campaign's epic artwork. One continuous widescreen scene; no square portrait, split screen, collage, frame, text, captions, logos or watermark. Reference 1 guides identity only, not composition.

references.role: Lan's established facial appearance and dark hair

request.alt: Lan stands on a windswept causeway beneath storm clouds, red magic gathering in his hand.
